strings.name: Paul Polman
strings.role: Consumer goods executive · Sustainable business advocate
strings.summary: Polman studied economics and management in the Netherlands and United States and worked at P&G, Nestlé and Unilever. Leading Unilever from 2009 through 2018, he linked sustainability, supply chains and long-term management but withdrew a headquarters relocation plan after shareholder opposition. He later co-founded IMAGINE and co-authored Net Positive, advocating environmental and social responsibility; these ideas remain subject to evaluation against business outcomes.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, not a live news archive.
